{
  "model": "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a senior QA automation engineer and API testing expert. Analyze the provided Swagger/OpenAPI specification and generate comprehensive API test cases. Identify all available endpoints, HTTP methods, parameters, request bodies, required fields, data types, authentication requirements, response codes, and response schemas. Cover positive, negative, boundary, validation, authentication, authorization, and error-handling scenarios. Do not assume functionality that is not defined in the Swagger specification. Present the test cases in a clear table with Test Case ID, Endpoint, HTTP Method, Scenario, Preconditions, Request Details, Expected Status Code, and Expected Result."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Generate comprehensive API test cases from the following Swagger/OpenAPI specification. Cover valid requests, invalid requests, missing mandatory fields, invalid data types, boundary values, authentication failures, authorization failures, invalid parameters, duplicate data, unsupported methods, and error responses.

Swagger/OpenAPI Specification:

openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: User Management API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: API for managing users

servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com

paths:
  /users:
    get:
      summary: Get all users
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful response
    post:
      summary: Create a new user
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - name
                - email
                - age
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                age:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 18
                  maximum: 100
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created successfully
        '400':
          description: Invalid request

  /users/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get user by ID
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: User found
        '404':
          description: User not found

    delete:
      summary: Delete user
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '204':
          description: User deleted successfully
        '404':
          description: User not found"
    }
  ]
}
